## Diagnosis

The `deployment/app` rollout was stuck at revision 2 because the Deployment referenced a key that did not exist on its Secret:

- Deployment pod template → `env: {name: APP_PASSWORD, valueFrom: secretKeyRef {name: app-secret, key: passwd}}` (nginx image needs the env to start; with an invalid reference it never started)
- `kubectl -n default get events` and the failing pod `app-c6d597897-l6h6w` showed:
  ```
  Warning  Failed  Error: couldn't find key passwd in Secret default/app-secret
  CreateContainerConfigError
  ```

The Secret `app-secret` only contained a key named `password` (`data.password = czNjcjN0` → `s3cr3t`), so the secret key name was simply missing/mismatched: no changes to the Deployment spec (no image fix needed, nothing there) and nothing about the node/scheduling changed.

## Fix (smallest change)

One new field on the existing Secret, preserving the original `password` entry:

```
kubectl -n default apply -f -  <<'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata: {name: app-secret, namespace: default}
data: {password: czNjcjN0, passwd: c2NyY3Q=}   # passwd = base64(s3cr3t)
EOF
```

Then `kubectl -n default rollout status deploy/app` completed: `deployment "app" successfully rolled out`. No pod deletions/restarts of the app workloads were performed.
